lines: Subbiah Vellayan, Investor Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 409,182 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹6.18 crore are scheduled on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Gain of ₹5.82 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained-share lock-in runs 6 months from allotment.
Retained holding is unknown: pre-offer holding not confirmed from the documents.
